title: Ticketo
tagline: World App mini-app for purchasing travel tickets with Worldcoin and USDC.e.
description: This project is a World App mini-app built using World MiniKit. It provides users a seamless, secure, and decentralized way to purchase travel tickets directly using Worldcoin and USDC.e. Users authenticate effortlessly with World ID, ensuring privacy and verification. Purchases are executed quickly on-chain, offering transparency and trust. Our solution simplifies the user experience in the travel industry by integrating blockchain payments directly into ticketing systems.
how_its_made: This project is a ticketing mini-app developed with World Mini App Kit, leveraging Next.js and TypeScript. By implementing World ID’s human verification, the app effectively prevents bots from bulk purchasing tickets. This is the first time our entire team has participated in ETHGlobal—we had a great experience and look forward to joining again!
